name: comp-102
blurb: Upvote and downvote buttons flanking a count display.
description: A grouped control with chevron-up and chevron-down buttons, a centered count badge, and accessible labels. Buttons are tightly grouped with negative margins.
use_when: Showing vote counts or ratings where users can upvote or downvote.
avoid_when: When you need state management or custom vote logic (this is presentation only).
a11y: Uses aria-label on buttons and aria-hidden on icons. Focus ring z-index prevents overlap.
